title: Two Messages Suffice for Quantum Interactive Proof Systems: Claimed Proof of QIP(2) = PSPACE
aiSystem: OpenAI Frontier Models (ChatGPT for Academic Researchers)
whyItMatters: An EPFL preprint developed interactively with OpenAI models claims QIP(2) = QIP = PSPACE—compressing quantum interactive proofs from three messages to two and tackling a 23-year open problem.
summary: Posted to arXiv on November 23, 2026 (arXiv:2611.31236) by Yupan Liu at EPFL, this preprint claims a resolution to one of quantum complexity theory’s flagship 23-year open questions: whether two-message quantum interactive proof systems capture all of PSPACE (QIP(2) = QIP = PSPACE), compressing the classic Kitaev–Watrous three-message parallelization theorem. Using quantum public coins (where the verifier sends halves of maximally entangled EPR pairs to the prover) and a stoquastic/classical-reversible verification reduction from TQBF via a sum-check uniformity problem (CIUniform), the paper establishes QIP(2) = qq-StoqAM = PSPACE. The author’s explicit AI disclosure reports interactive use of OpenAI models (via ChatGPT for Academic Researchers) across every stage from exploration and proof construction to revision.
technicalHighlights: Claims QIP(2) = QIP = PSPACE, settling a 23-year open question posed since Watrous (2003) and Jain–Ji–Upadhyay–Watrous (2010).
Constructs a two-message protocol where the verifier sends halves of EPR pairs ('quantum public coins') and verifies the prover’s single reply with stoquastic / classical reversible gates.
Proves PSPACE-hardness of CIUniform via one-step sum-check transitions for TQBF and places CIUniform inside qq-StoqAM.
caveats: Very recent November 23, 2026 arXiv preprint with no independent referee verdict or formal Lean verification yet; must be treated as an active-review claim until verified by quantum complexity specialists.

scoreRationale.foundational: If verified, collapses the entire round hierarchy of quantum interactive proof systems down to two messages (QIP(2) = PSPACE).
scoreRationale.ripple: Reshapes quantum complexity theory, quantum public-coin interactive protocols, and stoquastic verification hierarchies.
scoreRationale.verification: Fresh arXiv preprint (Nov 23, 2026) with no independent audit or formal Lean certificate yet—scored conservatively pending community verification.
scoreRationale.velocity: Single researcher interactively collaborating with OpenAI reasoning models cracked a 23-year complexity barrier.
